responsibility: This definition file is the master catalogue of GCC’s language-independent runtime parameters. For each --param setting it records the internal enum name, command-line option spelling, help text, default value, and either numeric bounds or an allowed set of symbolic values, covering tuning knobs used by many optimization and analysis passes. It is the authoritative source from which the parameter enums, tables, validation metadata, and generated helper includes are derived.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the X-macro-style source list of language-independent --param entries, enumerating names, help text, defaults, bounds, and enum-valued choices that params.c expands into tables and params.h-related generated enums/includes consume; unlike params.c or params.h, it is data definitions rather than executable code or API declarations.
